clips.name: mercator-market
clips.caption: Trading at JAKEL: the market opens, ORE is picked and A held buys it tonne after tonne until the hold shows 8 and the station has NONE LEFT HERE.

clips.name: mercator-jump
clips.caption: The chart in flight: the cursor steps from JAKEL to DRILO and XICRA, X zooms out to the whole galaxy and back, A jumps to DRILO through the tunnel, and the ship arrives there with a planet ahead.

stills.name: mercator-station
stills.caption: The ship flying back toward the station, with the planet behind the station and a hauler 1.9 km away.

clips.name: mercator-launch
clips.caption: Launching from JAKEL: just outside the station a warden on patrol, about 1 km ahead, comes closer and slides past on the left.

clips.name: mercator-flight
clips.caption: Flying in toward the station past a departing hauler and a passing warden, until the tow lane takes over.

clips.name: mercator-fight
clips.caption: A fight with a raider pack in a RISKY system, seen from behind the ship: the pilot's laser and the gunner's turret fire, the ship's shield takes hits, and two raiders are destroyed.

clips.name: mercator-entry
clips.caption: Down to the planet: the ship dives at the landing site's SITE beacon through the ring of amber lights, falls through streaks of entry, and levels off in a hover above the desert.

clips.name: mercator-landing
clips.caption: The ship sinks the last few metres onto the landing pad on its jets: LANDED, and then the pilot is out on foot.

clips.name: mercator-walk
clips.caption: The pilot walks across the landing site back to the ship.

stills.name: lantern-moth
stills.caption: A moth up close, drinking the lamp's oil.

clips.name: lantern-walk
clips.caption: A walk through lamplit tunnels: a crystal is picked up, then a wooden door slides open and the way goes on through it.

clips.name: lantern-flash
clips.caption: A moth flies at the lamp and drinks its oil; a flash of the lamp drives it off down the tunnel.

clips.name: lantern-lift
clips.caption: The lift's crank is picked up (THE CRANK! FIND THE LIFT), the lift waits at the end of the next tunnel, and A works it: THE LIFT CLIMBS, with the level's tally.

stills.name: lander-burn
stills.caption: The craft leaning and firing its engine to stop its sideways drift.

clips.name: lander-landing
clips.caption: The craft lowers itself onto the X1 pad with a short burn and then a low steady one, and touches down softly: LANDED, SOFT TOUCH +25, 158 points.

clips.name: lander-crash
clips.caption: Level 2 in the FOLLOW view: with no burn the craft falls, the camera zooms in near the ground, and it breaks apart: CRASHED, TOO FAST.

clips.name: lander-ridge
clips.caption: Low over the hills in the FOLLOW view, the craft leans back and burns to stop its sideways drift over a ridge, then sinks onto the X4 pad on top of it and lands.
